blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Nonperforming loans (NPLs) of digital lenders climbed to an “upper level” over the past three years amid the rapid expansion of easier-to-access, small and short-term loans that are bringing more Filipinos into the formal credit system, according to credit bureau CIBI Information Inc.
